messages:
alex_cartwright: FYI, after the kernel-selector change in commit 5e7a9c3 we see ~2x tail-latency regression for short sequences (seq=32) on p4d. Attached are two nsys captures (before/after) — before: https://artifacts/trace_before.nsys, after: https://artifacts/trace_after.nsys
maria_zhou: can you paste the exact command you used to profile? want to reproduce locally
alex_cartwright: ran on perf VM with minimal load:
```
nsys profile -o out_after --trace=cuda,nvtx,cudnn -f true --sample=none --capture-range=nvtx --nvtx-include=run_batch ./serve_bench --model redwood/7b --seq 32 --batch 1
```
jonas_perez: quick look at the after trace shows a big gap of memcpy and a few kernel launches waiting on cuBLAS-ish stuff. suspect KV-cache miss/rehydration happening between tokens
sophie_ng: @alex_cartwright can you dump the timeline with nsys UI -> events and snap the kernel names around the slowdown? also include KV cache debug logs (KV_EVICT/RELOAD)
alex_cartwright: added KV logs, looks like we evict at ~9s for identical prefix patterns. KV_RELOAD takes ~12ms and causes extra kernel sequence
perf-bot: regression-alert: tail_latency_p95 increased from 78ms -> 180ms in perf-ci/seq32 after change 5e7a9c3 :rotating_light:
maria_zhou: suggestion: try forcing old kernel selector with env OVERRIDE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy and repro — If that fixes, we know selector is root cause
alex_cartwright: tried OVERRIDE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy — latency back to ~80ms. Good signal. I'll bisect between previous stable and 5e7a9c3 focusing on kernel selection deltas
jonas_perez: when bisecting, capture light nsys profiles (10s) for each candidate, and script parsing for 'cuMemcpy' and 'nvtx' gaps. I can provide a small parser
sophie_ng: also check batching heuristic change in the same window — if selector moved some sequences to a 'long-kernel' path we'll see different kernel names (e.g., attention_fused_v2 vs attention_fused)
alex_cartwright: plan: 1) run git bisect to find first bad commit 2) for each commit run 3 nsys short captures + KV log 3) upload to artifacts and run jonas's parser 4) open a draft PR to revert selector change if bisect points to it
maria_zhou: +1. ping me when you have the first bad commit, I can help craft rollback and test on dedicated pool
alex_cartwright: starting bisect now. will drop periodic updates here and attach traces. first candidate capture uploaded: https://artifacts/bisect/try_1_after.nsys
jonas_perez: cool — if you want I can run a perfetto flame diff as well (less noisy than nsys for memcopy patterns)
sophie_ng: thanks team. small ask: include env vars (BATCHING_HINTS, KV_MAX_AGE) in each run so we can rule config differences
alex_cartwright: noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
